model: Orbital Economy v7.7.5 Regolith Capital candidate r1
note: Task 017 fragment. All numeric constants introduced by the Regolith Mine simple_capital declaration are annotated, including the intentionally asymmetric A/B initial capacities 7/5. Reviewer merges accepted entries into the canonical registry.

Regolith Capital Enabled.role: Regolith simple-capital master switch, raw value 1.
Regolith Capital Enabled.effect: 0 preserves accepted Modes 0-37 exactly; 1 makes regolith extraction capacity read mine capital and enables mine expansion, depreciation, retirement, and backing-resource sinks.

Regolith Mine Capacity Reserve Factor.effect: Scales the smoothed Regolith Demand Signal into desired mine capacity.

Regolith Mine Construction Time.effect: Divides the positive capacity gap to set desired expansion speed before backing-resource coverage limits it.

Regolith Mine Retirement Time.role: Mine-capacity surplus retirement time, value 360 days.
Regolith Mine Retirement Time.effect: Controls removal rate of capacity above desired capacity.

Regolith Mine Depreciation Rate.role: Mine-capacity depreciation rate, value 0.0001 per day.
Regolith Mine Depreciation Rate.effect: Applies continuous physical attrition to Regolith Mine Capacity while the mechanic is enabled.

Regolith Mine Capital Goods per Capacity.role: Capital Goods requirement per unit of new mine capacity, value 2.
Regolith Mine Capital Goods per Capacity.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Capital Goods demand and actual expansion into Capital Goods consumption.

Regolith Mine Construction Materials per.role: Construction Materials requirement per unit of new mine capacity, value 2.
Regolith Mine Construction Materials per.effect: Scales Desired Expansion into Construction Materials demand and actual expansion into Construction Materials consumption.

A Regolith Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital mine capacity for colony A, value 7.
A Regolith Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds mine capacity at the accepted A Regolith Base Extraction Capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (7 vs 5).
A Regolith Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_5_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §0–§2 explicitly require A=7, B=5.

B Regolith Mine Capacity.role: Initial simple-capital mine capacity for colony B, value 5.
B Regolith Mine Capacity.effect: Seeds mine capacity at the accepted B Regolith Base Extraction Capacity; A/B are intentionally asymmetric (7 vs 5).
B Regolith Mine Capacity.evidence: TASK_RU §2 and V7_7_5_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §0–§2 explicitly require A=7, B=5.

Regolith Demand Signal Adjustment Time.role: Regolith demand-signal adjustment time, value 3 days.
Regolith Demand Signal Adjustment Time.effect: Controls lag from instantaneous Regolith Requirement to the STOCK signal used for mine sizing and prevents same-step demand feedback.
Regolith Demand Signal Adjustment Time.evidence: V7_7_5_ARCHITECTURE_SPEC §1–§2; simple_capital STOCK sizing rule in lab/docs/NODES_RU.md.

A Regolith Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed Regolith demand signal for colony A, value 0.35.
A Regolith Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal without reading instantaneous demand directly.

B Regolith Demand Signal.role: Initial smoothed Regolith demand signal for colony B, value 0.35.
B Regolith Demand Signal.effect: Seeds the STOCK sizing signal without reading instantaneous demand directly.
